text: Debugging is an essential skill for any programmer. When you find that your code is not working correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by reproducing the problem and understanding what causes it. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you inspect your program while it runs. A systematic approach is important: test one change at a time and check the result before moving on. Logging is also very useful, because it records what your program does and helps you find where things go wrong. By combining these strategies, you can solve problems faster and write more reliable code.
